description: As Support Director at a telecommunications company, your escalation manager has left the company without documenting the status of ongoing critical incidents. Company policy mandates: (1) Any support case describing a service outage, system failure, or disruption affecting more than 500 users or endpoints must be classified as P1 (High) priority. (2) Every P1 case that has been open for more than 7 days must have its description updated with an escalation note beginning with '[ESCALATION REVIEW]' that documents the current situation and recommended next steps. (3) Every P1 case with status 'Open_New' must be changed to 'Open_Assigned' to indicate ownership. Review all cases in SuiteCRM, identify every policy violation, and bring all cases into compliance. Do not escalate cases that do not meet the impact threshold.

metadata.contamination_case: PDF export font rendering issue for 3 internal users
